Capgemini Information Technology Designation: Network Engineers Client:Société Generale Global Solution|| 3M India
28th Apr’21 to 16th July 26
Roles and Responsibilities 1)Join calls with customer to understand their requirement. 2)Replacement and refreshment & upgrade of existing network device such as FortiGate firewall,router,switches,ethernet (copper,fiber optics 10/40/100G). 3)prepare all pre-deployment documentation for replacement, refreshment, upgrades, and implementation. 4)Troubleshoot and resolve issues as they arise after migration. 5)Adding rule in FortiGate firewall 6)Designing rule & creating Incident Record arises after migration. 7)Do changes in network (which includes IOS upgradation, Route the traffic from Primary to secondary if Primary link is flapping, adding vlan, adding a routes) 8)Investigate health issues of ports and interfaces for routers and switches, ensuring connectivity with agreed speed, duplex, and bandwidth. 9)Attending weekly change approval board meeting for getting approval from change board.
10)Manage the delivery include validation, approval, feasibility, target delivery timeliness and implementation of order as per customer requirement. and ensure new equipment is registered and added to the inventory management system 11) Planning and implementing of customer changes, based around an ITIL framework. 12)coordinating with remote hand support engineer for the O&M activities. 13)Handle day to day security P3 and P4 incidents. 14)Working closely with partner management teams to such as Verizon, AT&T, SingTel,Telstra,OBS,COLT for provisioning new circuits activation and deactivation within SLA. and proper destruction and decommission of existing network device such as FortiGate firewall,router,switches 15)Timely completion of given activity and to generate daily link utilization report with SLA achievement more than 95%

sections.label: Skills
sections.text:
★Firewalls:Fortigate ★Routing Protocols: RIP,OSPF, EIGRP,BGP ★Switching Protocols: VLAN, STP,RSTP,VTP, Ether Channel ★Network Documentation: MS Word, MS Excel Microsoft Visio, Powerpoint, ★Processes : ITIL Framework, Change Management, Problem Management
Skill Set
Switching -Backup and restore device configuration. -Cisco IOS upgrades and recovery (FTP, TFTP) -Troubleshoot connectivity issue, verify and validate Link errors, CRC Errors. -Monitor Switch availability or any other error and perform Triage with the respective team to resolve the issue. -Carry out standard changes related to desktop ports. -Carry out standard configuration on switch according to the template. -Carry out VLAN mapping to the interface, port mapping. -VLAN configuration over switches and make machines communicate in LAN & WAN connectivity. -LAN technologies - Ethernet, Fast Ethernet, Gigabit Ethernet. -perform port aggregation & Link configuration: Access/Trunk. -Configuration and troubleshooting of VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, Interswitch connectivity. -Configuration and troubleshooting of Trunk ports, VTP (v1&v2). -Configuration and troubleshooting of STP protocols and STP protection. -Implemented CDP, LLDP, EtherChannel.
-Configuration HSRP, VRRP.
Routing -Backup and restore device configuration -Troubleshoot network connectivity issues using ICMP, ping, and traceroute -Monitor routers and links for hardware and performance issues. -Triage for Link issues with appropriate vendors. -Troubleshooting, overutilization, Reachability, VPN connectivity. -Apply standard SOP based configuration on the router.(AAA,TACACS,Radius,Banner,VPN Configurations) -Configuration of NAT/PAT,ACL -Configuration/Troubleshoot of Static, Dynamic (OSPF & EIGRP), and Default Routing protocols. -Configure, verify, and troubleshoot IPv4 addressing, Subnetting,Supernetting, ARP, and Route Summarization -Basics of BGP
Firewall: - -Restore and backup device settings -Used Fortinet Manager to Upgrades/installs OS to Fortigate Firewalls in accordance with recommendations to maintain them up to date. -Using FortiManager, provision firewall policies on Fortinet FortiGate appliances. -Implementing rules to allow or restrict IPs, and creating policies in response to requests from business users. -FortiGate CPE 40/60/80/100 series Firewall configuration, management, and FortiAnalyzer series 4000 (logging and reporting server), FortiManager series 3000/4000 (centralized control) firewalls -Analyze the logs and troubleshoot any connectivity problems.
WLAN -Monitor WAP, and Triage issue with respective teams. -Troubleshooting Connectivity issue from an end-user perspective. -Troubleshooting the WAP isolation issue, Cannot Connect to SSID,Slow Performance, Intermittent Disconnections
